function.arguments: {"finding": "The `customer_age` column contains -1 to represent missing age data, not an actual age. Using the raw mean would include these -1 values and produce a biased result. The data dictionary explicitly states that -1 means the customer did not supply an age and should not be treated as a valid age.", "implication": "We must exclude -1 values before computing the mean age. function.name: note_finding
